body:
**What changed**
- **Update hint:** when the recommended mod has a new version, the Mods entry in the sidebar shows a small blue **UPDATE**, on every page. It goes away after the update.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_1.5.4.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
